from flask import Flask, request, render_template
import sqlite3

app = Flask(__name__)

def get_db():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('messages.db')
    conn.execute('CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, content TEXT)')
    return conn

@app.route('/')
def index():
    conn = get_db()
    # Retrieve posts from database
    posts = conn.execute('SELECT id, content FROM posts').fetchall()
    conn.close()
    return render_template('index.html', posts=posts)

@app.route('/submit', methods=['POST'])
def submit():
    content = request.form.get('message')
    conn = get_db()
    # Insert user message directly into query
    query = f"INSERT INTO posts (content) VALUES ('{content}')"
    conn.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    return 'Post submitted', 302

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run(debug=True)
